lines.t: Minecraft sold about 1,000 copies in its first month.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); youngston; Eider (YouTube)

lines.t: Notch put it up for sale so he could work on it full time. The first copy sold on June 13th, 2009.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); youngston; Eider (YouTube)

lines.t: About 20,000 more people signed up to play the free version.

full.credit: Clips: Notch's Cave Game test (re-upload); youngston; Eider (YouTube)

lines.t: Today it's the best selling video game of all time.
